name: rsvp-mode
title: RSVP Mode
description: Speed-read articles word-by-word (RSVP) with synced local text-to-speech.
author: shemtovo

commands.name: open
commands.title: RSVP a URL
commands.subtitle: RSVP Mode
commands.description: Speed-read any URL with synced text-to-speech.

commands.name: open-clipboard
commands.title: RSVP Clipboard URL
commands.subtitle: RSVP Mode
commands.description: Speed-read the URL currently on your clipboard.

commands.name: open-current-tab
commands.title: RSVP Current Browser Tab
commands.subtitle: RSVP Mode
commands.description: Speed-read the active tab in your frontmost browser.

preferences.name: wpm
preferences.title: Reading Speed
preferences.description: Words per minute. macOS pre-renders audio at this rate and the visual flash is timed to match.

preferences.name: voice
preferences.title: Voice
preferences.description: macOS TTS voice. Leave blank for the system default. List installed voices with `say -v ?` in Terminal. Premium voices (Ava, Zoe, Evan) can be downloaded in System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Manage Voices.

preferences.name: enableTTS
preferences.title: Text-to-Speech
preferences.description: Read each chunk aloud while flashing words. Disable for silent speed-reading.
preferences.label: Speak aloud

preferences.name: enablePaywallHopper
preferences.title: Paywall Hopper
preferences.description: Try to retrieve paywalled content from archive services when the original page is blocked.
preferences.label: Enable

preferences.name: skipPreCheck
preferences.title: Skip Readability Check
preferences.description: Skip readability detection and always attempt RSVP rendering.
preferences.label: Skip

preferences.name: verboseLogging
preferences.title: Debug Logging
preferences.description: Print synthesis and playback diagnostics to the dev console.
preferences.label: Enable
